bandos.name: Chiari e Forti
bandos.about: The old Chiari e Forti oil factory on the Sile river: brick and ochre blocks with broken roofs, the roofless mill with its battlemented tower by the river, the water tower and the Olio Cuore sign tower.

bandos.name: Playground
bandos.about: A made-up works on the edge of the fields, with no real place: a barrel-vault store, a warehouse with a basement, a ruined tower and farmhouse, a pond, hills with a tunnel, and every block of the library, from gates to cranes.

bandos.name: Villetta (place hidden)
bandos.about: The Villetta main store shared without its place: no map and no map data, its real ground travels inside. Open a copy, edit it, load your flights: they start on the take-off pad, and pins and the compass fit them.
